name: acta/console-webhook
description: Console and webhook adapters for event-sourced PHP 8.5+ applications: operational commands, signed incoming webhooks translated to commands, and reliable outgoing webhooks with retries and dead letters.

suggest.acta/http: Enables the openapi:lint command and the validation of outgoing webhooks against the OpenAPI contract.
suggest.acta/oidc: Enables the auth:login and auth:logout commands.
suggest.ext-pcntl: Lets long-running commands stop cleanly on SIGINT and SIGTERM.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Required by the PostgreSQL delivery log and delivery queue, and by the es:migrate command.
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Required to reuse the contract test suites shipped in Acta\Webhook\Testing.

scripts-descriptions.check: Runs the coding standard, static analysis and the whole test suite.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Runs the tests that do not need a PostgreSQL server.
scripts-descriptions.stan: Analyses the library at the max level, then the tests.
